name: cbox-brain
description: Cbox Brain, your team's shared memory, wired into Claude Code: the project's context at session start (and again after a compaction), what changed in Brain on every prompt, a gate before deploy-shaped commands against the team's policies, the last session's handoff and the open reminders, reminders to remember and hand off unfinished work before the answer, and what was learned and what is left carried through a compaction. Install everything with `curl -fsSL https://app.cboxbrain.com/install | sh`, or by hand: sign in with `node scripts/brain.mjs login` and connect the MCP server with `claude mcp add --scope user cbox-brain -- node <plugin>/scripts/brain.mjs mcp --agent claude-code` (one sign-in for hooks and tools, the repository picks the organization, and every brain_remember carries a client_key so a retry is recorded once). Opt out with BRAIN_HOOKS=off or a .brain-ignore file.
